_about: What the group B manage partials had BEFORE the wave 21b rebuild (tests/kit-rollout-b.test.js stubs): ids, form field names, data-* attributes, form routes, inline handlers, the ids and classes their scripts look up, and the paths their scripts call. The rebuilt partials must keep every one.

_changes: wave 22 kit-polish: rpg lost its 12 inline onmouseover/onmouseout handlers (they repainted a border the kit no longer draws), so its handlers list is empty; starboard is rebuilt on the kit and checked with the rest (its entry is the pre-rebuild capture, unchanged).

gap wave 1 (2026-11-18): starboard became several boards with more options (multi-board editor, emoji list, watched and ignored channels, per-channel thresholds, bot/age/removal rules). Its entry gained the new field names, ids and script hooks; nothing it had was dropped.
2026-11-18 UI pass follow-up: achievements gained #ach-save-status (save result shown inline).

2026-11-18 kit-drift review, removals: birthday's per-card customise fields are now f-birthday-<field>-<card id> (they were repeated for every card, so ids clashed and labels focused the first card's control); the settings search skips EJS-built ids by design, so they left it, and the page's dead .card-type-option script went with the old choice cards. games: the counting reset form went (counting has its own page with Set count). owo: the sub-command lists, top hunters list and commands table became #owoSubs, the leaderboard tabs (#owoLbBody) and the shared command list; the settings search finds the number inputs now (#owoCooldownNum and the three multipliers, same labels). feeds: the add-a-subreddit form (subreddit, #f-feeds-subreddit, #f-feeds-channel_id, POST add-reddit-feed) only renders when REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET are set (the owner retired Reddit). community-support: the affiliate / non-affiliate link channels are hidden inputs (nothing in the bot reads them), so the search no longer lists them. economy: the delete confirm says members keep the item. free-games: the inline fg* onclick handlers became delegated data-fg-act buttons. streaming: the team modal posts teamId to update-team (since the 2026-11-07 team live board), not teamSubscriptionId.

2026-11-18 kit-drift review, additions: achievements #ach-search; confessions enabled, min/max length and cooldown (#cfs-*) and the private sender reveal (/confessions/:id/sender); giveaways host roles (#gw-host-roles, #gw-hosts-*, /api/guilds/:id/giveaways/host-roles); polls hide_results; games trivia/hangman lists and question preview (#gm-*); counting #cntCount; minigames Cat Bot options and preview (#mg*); owo #owoPage, #owoSubs, #owoCmdCount; rpg game channel (POST rpg/channel); economy weekly reward, crime, rob, gifting/trading and per-member item limits (read by core/economy-manager.js); trading #td-history-body, #td-none; free-games edit dialog (#fgEditModal, #fg-edit-*); game-news search and preview (#gn-*); steam-library preview (#slPv*, #slMemberCount); streaming departed-streamer and restore tools, team live board, Twitch role grants, analytics tab and their API paths; event-schedule custom_message; community-support #csPage. The script-hook check now also counts ids looked up through a page's own getElementById helper ($('id')), which is why economy, owo, free-games and game-news hooks no longer read as lost.

fixwave B (2026-11-19, H-662): suggestions gained the Anonymous suggestions switch (#allowAnonymous, field allow_anonymous; the dashboard save never set it) and the hidden suggestions_form_v2 marker, so a page loaded before the switch existed does not turn anonymous suggestions off.

accuracy pass (2026-11-19, levels and engagement): birthday cards gained the hidden subtitle_font_color_shown field. The subtitle colour picker was given #ffffff99, which a colour input reads as black, so saving a card made an unset subtitle black; the picker now shows a valid colour and the save keeps the stored colour unless the picker was changed.

2026-11-19 final-b (H-715): giveaways gained the Create giveaway panel control (#gw-panel-channel with #gw-panel-channel-desc, #gw-panel-status, #gw-panel-save); its script calls GET/PUT /api/guilds/:id/giveaways/panel (core/giveaway-panel.js), which posts, updates, moves or removes the panel the host roles gate.

2026-11-19 licence cleanup (clean-room critters rewrite): the owo page (page key owo) renders the new partial critters.ejs; the old owo.ejs entry is replaced by a capture of critters.ejs taken when it was written. It is a new page, not a rebuild of the old one.

2026-11-20 fix wave 5: streaming gained the auto-track Minimum level fields (min_level, #f-streaming-min_level, #at-minlevel-<id>; H-810); self-promo gained the live-promotion switch (live_promo_filter, #sp-live-filter, section sp-livefilter-title; H-811); achievements lost data-feature-switch on its announcements switch (it is not a master switch, H-808); minigames reworded.
